name: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Marker
tagline: ROAD MARKER FOR GRASS AND GRAVEL PAVER MODULES
summary: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Marker is a white road marker designed to demarcate temporary or permanent spaces atop grass or gravelled areas. Marker modules are manufactured from polypropylene (PP) are available in white, with other colours subject to availability. SikaRoof® TurfPave® Marker are push-fitted into any cell on SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3255

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Marker is push-fitted into pre-determined cells of SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD to create the desired design according to specifications.
